specs.label: DC Power Input
specs.value: 2.1 mm ID barrel connector, 48 VDC, 0.2A, center positive

specs.label: Sleep/Power Save Mode
specs.value: Shuts off IR when no audio present for 12 minutes

specs.label: Modulation
specs.value: FM Wideband, ±50 kHz deviation max, 50 μS pre-emphasis

specs.label: Coverage Area
specs.value: Up to 32,000 sq. ft (2,972 sq. m) in single-channel mode with the RX22-4 receiver Up to 19,000 sq. ft (1,774 sq. m) with the RX20 stethoset receiver

specs.label: Microphone channel switch
specs.value: Selects microphone input to Ch. A or Ch. B

specs.label: Microphone input
specs.value: 3.5 mm, stereo jack with signal and bias connected to tip, electret microphone compatible (6 VDC bias supply with 2.7 k ohm series resistor)

specs.label: Audio Inputs
specs.value: Line inputs: Phoenix style connector jack for Ch A and Ch B accept line level, balanced or unbalanced audio

specs.label: Audio Indicators
specs.value: One yellow LED per channel. Lights up and stay on steady with minimum audio level.
